items.question: How quickly will I see results?
items.answer: Most orders start processing within 1-6 hours and complete within 24-72 hours depending on the service and quantity. Some services like Instagram likes can start immediately.

items.question: Are the followers/likes real?
items.answer: Yes, we provide high-quality engagement from real, active accounts. We never use bots or fake profiles. All our services comply with platform guidelines.

items.question: Is it safe for my account?
items.answer: Our services comply with all platform guidelines and we use gradual delivery methods to ensure account safety. We've been in business for years with zero account bans.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept various payment methods including PayPal, credit cards, cryptocurrency, and local payment methods for your convenience.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes, we offer refunds for undelivered orders or if you're not satisfied with the quality. Please contact our support team within 30 days of your order.

items.question: Can I track my order progress?
items.answer: Yes! You can track all your orders in real-time through your dashboard. You'll also receive email notifications about order status updates.
